scientific_integrity: The finite arithmetic verifier checks root localization and selected Blaschke identities. Infinite and uniform claims follow from the written analytic proof, not experiments. The formula and sharpness refer only to derivative-subordination with a finite vanishing Taylor jet.
scientific_limitations: The class is locally univalent, not assumed globally univalent; the exact radial envelope is an explicit one-variable maximization. The sharp global constant is nonattained at interior points for m>=2. No equivalence-free novelty guarantee is claimed. The source paper treats a globally univalent subclass, whose exact sharp constant is not established here.
title: Sharp finite-jet pre-Schwarzian distortion for an exponential-sine derivative class
